summary: SDK bundle triggers generic keyword patterns without confirmed installer harm
details: The package ships a bundled JavaScript SDK (dist/index.js) in which multiple HTTP POST call sites and a 'dyndns' keyword co-occur inside a minified bundle. No lifecycle scripts, no environment-variable scraping, no credential-path reads, no hardcoded attacker endpoints bound to install/require-time code, and no fetch-and-execute behavior are present. The POST call sites correspond to the SDK's own configurable HTTP client used by the exported API, and the 'dyndns' occurrence appears as an incidental substring in the bundled code rather than a network destination. Behavior is consistent with a normal SDK bundle rather than a supply-chain attack.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
